title: caps-scout
name: caps-scout
description: Host capability discovery: ships a 'Capabilities Scout' service listing every caps-scout caps/* host label, from both the Rust agent plugin (databases, web/app servers, containers, clustering, backup, and more - see the README) and the SNMP plugin-match labels below (each with an 'Add rule' chip to the matching bakery rule where one exists). Also emits caps/snmp_plugin/<family> host labels identifying which of Checkmk's SNMP device plugin families (cisco, juniper, fortinet, aruba, hp_procurve, checkpoint, palo_alto, f5_bigip) would attach to this host, using the host's already-configured SNMP credentials, and ships a bakery rule to deploy the caps-scout agent plugin itself.
author: Andrea Vaccaro <andrea.vaccaro@gmail.com>
